entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-08
entry.content:
Issues

Updated

  • MediaPicker.CapturePhotoAsync uses the camera Intent, so requiring android.permission.CAMERA is unnecessary #32431
  • HybridWebView in Windows .NET 9 cannot take json string arguments (must base64 the string) #32438
  • CollectionView, CarouselView and ScrollView have a privacy-overlay covering its content. only the edges are not affected. #32159
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [iOS 26] Navigation hangs after rapidly open and closing new page using Navigation.PushAsync #32425
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android] Setting layout to container and SoftInput on bottom causes padding to not calculate quite right #31871
    .NET 10.0 SR2

PullRequests

Created

  • [iOS 26] Navigation hangs after rapidly open and closing new page using Navigation.PushAsync - fix #32456
    area-navigation, platform/ios, community ✨, version/iOS-26

Updated

  • Fix Shell and NavigationPage TitleView covering content on iOS 26 #32341
    p/0, .NET 10.0 SR1
  • Fix keyboard overlap on Android when SoftInput.AdjustResize is set #32405
    p/0, .NET 10.0 SR1
  • Fix XC0022 and XC0023 warnings by adding x:DataType for compiled bindings #32444
  • Fix SafeAreaEdges.SoftInput applying bottom padding when keyboard is hidden and inset consumption issue #32064
    platform/android, platform/ios, p/0, .NET 10.0 SR1
  • [Net10] CV2 - Disable scrolling and bouncing when empty view is shown #31973
    platform/ios, community ✨, collectionview-cv2
  • [iOS] Fix DatePicker to consistently display 4-digit years #32451
    platform/ios, p/0, area-controls-datetimepicker, .NET 10.0 SR1
  • [Android] Fix SafeArea padding calculation with AdjustPan and Container+SoftInput #31998
    t/bug, platform/android, p/0, area-keyboard, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr1] Fix SafeAreaEdges.SoftInput applying bottom padding when keyboard is hidden and inset consumption issue #32448
